text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important area is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. NLP is also used for translation, so people can read texts in different languages more easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies learn whether customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with users in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily digital life is becoming simpler and more convenient.
